user_question: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College census tract zones
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain the census tract polygon layer needed as zonal-statistics zones.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked catalog dataset representing census tract polygons covering the State College area identified by input_3. Prefer a GeoPackage polygon dataset suitable for zonal statistics. Do not infer or fabricate coverage, geometry, CRS, or census tract identity; downstream control must verify the returned metadata.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the mean elevation for each State College census tract using elevation data at 30-meter resolution.
workflow_steps.instructions: Run zonal statistics using input_2, the 30-meter GeoTIFF, as the elevation raster and census_tract_zones as the polygon zones. Compute the mean elevation for each census tract and return a CSV summary table. Input_1 is an available co-registered 90-meter alternative but is not the requested analysis resolution; use input_2 for the requested result.

requirements.scope: The retrieved census tract zones must be a GeoPackage polygon layer accepted by zonal_statistics.
The retrieved census tract zones must cover the State College area represented by input_3.
The retrieved census tract zones must have valid, non-empty polygon geometries.
The elevation raster used for the requested result must have a pixel resolution no coarser than 30 meters.
The elevation raster and census tract zones must have matching coordinate reference systems for zonal statistics.
The census tract zones supplied to zonal statistics must be valid polygon geometries.
